idea-plugin.name: Spring Boot CRUD Generator
idea-plugin.description: Spring Boot CRUD Generator generates production-ready CRUD layers for Spring Boot applications directly from JPA entities with advanced features and multi-entity support.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.0.7

  • 🚀 Upgrade: Migrated to IntelliJ Platform Gradle Plugin 2.x
  • 🚀 Compatibility: Updated for IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3+
  • 🔧 Fix: Improved build compatibility and removed upper build restriction

action.description: Generate complete CRUD layer with multi-entity support, Swagger, Pagination, Auditing, Exception Handling, and optional JWT Security
